method: World-space GPU diagnostic probes at each original fixture receiver position + normal*0.02, with normalized receiver normal and white Lambertian receiver albedo. Total includes visible diffuse sky and reflected light. BounceOnly excludes sky paths that escape before hitting a secondary surface. Neither query adds primary direct sun. These raw linear radiances do not include the actual receiver material, exposure, tone mapping or screen upsampling.
timingMeaning: Each query synchronously dispatches and reads back the stated sample budget. Diagnostic milliseconds include GPU completion and CPU readback; they are not regular interactive GI frame costs. Mutations settle for two frames before querying; this test measures transport after update, not minimum update latency.
comparisonMeaning: Checks describe only the recorded diagnostic receivers and sample budget. Geometrically restored and camera-only comparisons use identical world rays if SampleProbes is deterministic. A positive BounceOnly value proves a reflected path at this receiver; it does not establish visual quality or lack of leaks everywhere.
